about:
# Spell DPS Tooltips

A lightweight World of Warcraft addon (supporting World of Warcraft: Forever, Classic Era, and Anniversary) that calculates and displays the Damage Per Second (DPS) for both Direct Damage and Damage over Time (DoT) spells entirely through their in-game tooltips.

## Calculated Metrics

Depending on the type of spell, the addon will calculate and inject the following metrics:

- **Direct DPS:** Calculates the average DPS of a direct-damage spell. Uses the damage (or average of a damage range) divided by the cast time. For instant spells, it divides by the cooldown or a 1.5s GCD.
- **DoT DPS:** Parses DoT or channeled effects (e.g., "X damage over Y sec" or "X damage every 1 sec for 3 sec") and calculates the DPS.
- **Est. Total Damage:** For spells that have both an initial direct-damage hit *and* a DoT component, this line sums the maximum estimated damage for the entire cast.
- **Est. Cycle DPS:** For hybrid spells (Direct + DoT), this line shows the DPS over the entire lifecycle of the spell. It calculates this by dividing the *Est. Total Damage* by the combined duration of the Cast Time + DoT Duration.

## Installation

1. Download the latest release from the repository.
2. Extract the `SpellDPSTooltips` folder to your WoW directory:
   - **Forever WoW:** `_classic_beta_\Interface\AddOns\SpellDPSTooltips`
   - **Anniversary / Classic Era:** `_anniversary_\Interface\AddOns\SpellDPSTooltips` (or `_classic_era_\Interface\AddOns\SpellDPSTooltips`)
3. Launch the game and enable "Spell DPS Tooltips" in your addons list.

## Usage

Simply hover over any spell in your spellbook or on your action bars that deals direct damage, or applies a DoT effect. One or more new lines will be added to the bottom of the tooltip displaying the calculated DPS.

## Contributing

Pull requests and issues are welcome! If you find any spells whose tooltips use phrasing that isn't parsed correctly by the addon, feel free to open an issue or submit a fix for the regex pattern!

# Spell DPS Tooltips

## [v1.1.1](https://github.com/malkamius/SpellDPSTooltips/tree/v1.1.1) (2026-11-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/malkamius/SpellDPSTooltips/commits/v1.1.1) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/malkamius/SpellDPSTooltips/releases)

- fix(core): handle secret values on action bar tooltips  
    - Add IsSecret, IsSafeValue, and IsSafeString guards using issecretvalue,  
      issecrettable, and canaccessvalue APIs.  
    - Prevent attempts to index or compare secret strings during tooltip  
      scanning, resolving Lua errors on action bar buttons.  
    - Wrap ProcessSpellTooltip in pcall to isolate tooltip post-calls.  
    - Fix deploy.ps1 and package.ps1 to target the base addon folder rather  
      than flavor TOC filenames.  
- ci: add GitHub/CurseForge release workflow  
- chore(deploy): add \_forever\_ client target  
- feat: add World of Warcraft: Forever compatibility  
    - Add support for World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001 / Camelot)  
    - Register modern TooltipDataProcessor.AddTooltipPostCall with fallback to OnTooltipSetSpell for legacy clients  
    - Add text sanitization to strip WoW formatting and color codes (|c, |cn, |r, |T, |A) for accurate regex parsing  
    - Add SpellDPSTooltips\_Camelot.toc flavor TOC  
    - Prevent duplicate tooltip lines on tooltip updates  
    - Update deploy and package scripts to support multiple WoW addon paths  
    - Bump addon version to 1.1.0  
- chore: update interface versions to support Classic Era and TBC  
    - Updated interface versions to 11508 (Classic Era) and 20505 (TBC)  
    - Bumped addon version to 1.0.2  
- chore: update interface version to 11508 for classic era  
- removed placeholder image
